200 Returned if Tenable PCI ASV successfully retrieved the details for the specified PCI attestation.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
object (Response-AttestationList)
— 400 Returned if you do not have a license to use Tenable PCI ASV.
— 403
Returned if you do not have the required permissions to view the details of attestations. For example, if
you're an analyst user instead of an administrator.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in Tenable PCI ASV.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
attestation_uuid
required
items
required
integer
The HTTP status code of the error.
string
The standard HTTP error name.
string
A brief message about the cause of the error.
